headline: Approved overnight field trips to Ecology School and Greece, plus personnel items and prior minutes.
summary: The meeting covered an enrollment update, a fund balance update, and a food service presentation. Projected enrollment is 2,418 students, down 36 from the prior year.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda of personnel items, including one nomination, one appointment, and four resignations, unanimously.
Approved the second reading of the overnight Ecology School field trip for BMS 7th grade, unanimously.
Approved the first reading of the overnight World Language trip to Greece in April 2028, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion by Marie Potvin, seconded by Amy Clearwater, to approve the September 23, 2026 minutes. Motion carried unanimously.
Motion by Marie Potvin, seconded by Amy Clearwater, to approve the consent agenda. Motion carried unanimously.
Marie Potvin moved, and Amy Clearwater seconded, to approve the second reading of the overnight Ecology School field trip. Motion carried unanimously.

Marie Potvin moved, seconded by Amy Clearwater, to approve the first reading of the overnight World Language trip to Greece in April 2028, with teachers Cassily and McGovern in charge. Motion carried unanimously.
